## Checklist

- [ ] I read the [contribution guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] This pull request adds or changes **one** resource.
- [ ] The resource is about learning Go, high quality, and still relevant.
- [ ] I searched the list and it is not a duplicate.
- [ ] The link works and has no tracking parameters.
- [ ] The entry follows the format: ``- [Title](URL) - `Level` `Free` One-sentence description.``
- [ ] The description is in my own words, starts with a capital letter, ends with a period, and has no marketing language.
- [ ] The entry has a level tag (or none for general references) and a `Free` or `Paid` tag.
- [ ] The entry is placed in level order, then alphabetical order, within its section.
- [ ] If I am the author of the resource, I said so above.
